# Wake v0.2.2

Wake v0.2.2 publishes the runtime package aligned with Wake's final Beagle
ClojureScript compiler surface.

## Compiler compatibility

- Wake now consumes exact Beagle producer
  `75ef28442092572c274e71d8dbd1bfdd37c5e866` in CI and release verification.
- The compiler stages Beagle's canonical JavaScript artifacts directly while
  preserving the checked declaration and Store projection contracts.

## Runtime package

- The checked runtime package remains source-bound to its annotated tag,
  commit, exact file closure, and deterministic archive receipt.
- Store gateway, HTTP, adapter, receipt, safe-document, and worker-host public
  surfaces remain included in the closed package contract.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tompassarelli/wake/compare/v0.2.1...v0.2.2
